components.css: .ds-ground { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5a3a22, #2a1d14); padding: 12px; width: 384px; font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro', system-ui; } .ds-pill { position: relative; width: 360px; height: 56px; border-radius: 28px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 10px 0 8px; box-sizing: border-box; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.6); border: 0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); } .ds-pill-art { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c9772f, #5b2a14); flex: none; } .ds-pill-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-pill-title { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-pill-sub { font-size: 10px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); margin-top: 1px; } .ds-pill-progress { position: absolute; left: 26px; right: 26px; bottom: 3px; height: 2px; border-radius: 1px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); } .ds-pill-progress span { display: block; width: 30%; height: 100%; border-radius: 1px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); } .ds-pp { border: none; border-radius: 50%; background: #0A84FF; color: #fff; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; flex: none; } .ds-pp-36 { width: 36px; height: 36px; } .ds-pp:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(10,132,255,0.6); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-glyph { border: none; background: transparent; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; flex: none; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-glyph-28 { width: 28px; height: 28px; } .ds-glyph:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); } .ds-glyph:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(10,132,255,0.6); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
Encore is one piece of Liquid Glass hanging under the menu bar. At rest it is a 56pt capsule carrying the artwork, the title over the artist, a play/pause button and an expand chevron. Expanding does not open another window: the same glass shape grows downward into a 620pt drawer, and the artwork moves with it, from a 40pt circle in the pill to a large rounded square in the drawer. Collapsing runs the same movement in reverse.

The ground under the glass belongs to the music. The current cover, blurred and laid at half opacity under the panel, gives the whole player that cover's colour, so the palette changes with every track and the chrome brings no colour of its own. The one fixed colour is the system accent, and it appears only on controls that start playback. Everything else is drawn in hierarchical system foregrounds (primary, secondary, tertiary) and a short ladder of translucent primary fills. Type is SF Pro at macOS system text styles, and every icon is an SF Symbol.

The density is that of a menu bar utility: small, close, and quick to dismiss. There is no YouTube or YouTube Music branding anywhere in the chrome. Liked Songs uses Encore's own heart tile instead of the service's artwork.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous glass shape, 360pt wide, in two heights: pill (56pt) and drawer (620pt).
The artwork tints the panel. The chrome adds no colour except the accent.
The accent fills play controls and nothing else.
SF Pro system text styles and SF Symbols only. Hierarchy comes from weight and from the primary, secondary and tertiary foregrounds, never from new colours.
Icon-only controls have no chrome at rest. They show a soft circular fill on hover.
Scrolling lists fade out at their top and bottom edges instead of being cut off by the frame.

rules.name: The Accent Means Play Rule
rules.body: The accent appears only on controls that start or pause playback: the play/pause circle and a collection's Play button. Navigation, selection, sliders and toggles use the primary foreground. Sliders are tinted `.primary`, and the selected tab is a primary fill, never the accent.

rules.name: The Cover Owns the Colour Rule
rules.body: The chrome adds no hue of its own. Panel colour comes from the artwork tint under the glass, and every overlay is a primary-foreground opacity from the fill ladder, so the panel stays readable against any cover.

rules.name: The System Styles Rule
rules.body: Set type with system text styles (`.title3`, `.headline`, `.callout`, `.subheadline`, `.caption`, `.caption2`) and weights. Never use fixed point sizes, except for SF Symbols sized relative to their control (the play glyph is 0.4 of the button diameter).

rules.name: The Numbers Hold Still Rule
rules.body: Any number that changes while you watch it (times, percentages) uses monospaced digits.

rules.name: The Two Glasses Rule
rules.body: There are exactly two glass surfaces: the panel itself and the tab capsule. Rows, fields, badges and buttons are opacity fills on the panel's glass, never glass of their own.

dos: Do keep the panel at 360pt wide, 56pt as a pill and 620pt as a drawer, with a 28pt corner radius, inside a 12pt margin.
Do put new drawer content inside the existing glass, using fills from the ladder (0.06 to 0.20) for plates, fields and selection.
Do use the accent only for controls that start or pause playback, with a white glyph.
Do build icon controls as Glyph Buttons: an SF Symbol, a circular hit area, a 0.10 hover fill, a `.help` tooltip and an accessibility label.
Do fade scrolling lists at their edges and hide their scroll indicators.
Do use SwiftUI system text styles and monospaced digits for changing numbers.
Do keep the expand spring at response 0.42 / damping 0.86 and provide the Reduce Motion ease-in-out.
Do check the light appearance and the ducked state against real captures before relying on them. Neither has been verified.
donts: Don't use the accent for selection, sliders, links or navigation. Those use `.primary`.
Don't add YouTube or YouTube Music logos or brand colours to the chrome.
Don't add new glass layers for rows, cards or buttons. The panel and the tab capsule are the only glass.
Don't open a separate window or popover for player content. It grows inside the drawer.
Don't introduce fixed brand colours. The artwork tint supplies the panel's colour.
